rules: domains = union of the kind's domains and the domains added by each context whose effect on the kind is adds-domain.
A context never removes a domain.
classification is unresolved if the kind, any applied context claim, or the jurisdiction is unresolved; otherwise resolved.
A domain added by a context applies to the occurrence only, never to the base kind.
A base kind is not duplicated to represent phi; the occurrence composes kind plus context.
A dedicated kind is created only when the identifier itself is health-domain specific.
externalRefs to ner-evidence carry repository, pinned snapshot identity and entity id; no names or spans are copied.
